rows.text: The first addition says the ceremony of the oath and of the opening of the first year of the Council's sixth term (افتتاح أعمال السنة الأولى من الدورة السادسة للمجلس) began with Quran recitation, and prints King Abdullah's address opening that year, the first term in which women take part.
